# Cncf Kodekloud Kcntp Reviewer

Review KodeKloud (KCNTP) using its official documentation and repository in the Special / Kubernetes and Cloud Native Training Partner category. KodeKloud provides Interactive Hands-On training on Cloud Native Computing technologies using immersive learning techniques to help spread awareness of CNCF and its projects around the world.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
